Resigned with 1 XP in the victory display (Screeching Byakhee, Victory 1) and ZERO trauma, but 'ahlcg score' and 'campaign record' both report score 0, not 1. docs_agent/scenario_reference.md states 'Benchmark score = XP - trauma suffered (minimum 0)', which gives 1 - 0 = 1. For comparison, in this same campaign return_to_the_midnight_masks recorded 2 XP / 0 trauma / score 2, and a prior Daisy campaign recorded return_to_the_gathering no_resolution with 3 XP / 1 trauma / score 2 - both consistent with XP - trauma. Skids' Hospital Debts (-2 XP if under 6 resources) was NEVER drawn this run and is not in play, so it should not be deducting. Either devourer no_resolution is intentionally hardcoded to score 0 (in which case the docs should say so, since it makes victory-display XP worthless on a resign) or the -2 weakness penalty is being applied without the card being in play.
